beats.narration_text: Roll a ball at a hill too steep to climb, and it always rolls back down.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Roll a ball at a hill too steep to climb, and it always rolls back down.
beats.new_visual_element: a person rolling a ball up a steep hill; it rolls back
beats.start_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = a person rolling a ball toward a steep hill]
beats.end_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = the person watching the ball roll back down the steep hill]
beats.video_animation_prompt: the person and steep hill draw in, a ball rolls partway up and rolls back down; no hand visible, white background, napkin art doodle style
beats.negative_prompt: hand, fingers, arm, pencil, pen, marker, stylus, writing tool, shadow, paper texture, yellowing, gradient, photorealistic, 3D render, gray shading, color, brush, eraser, artifacts, distortion, camera movement, zoom, pan, wiggle, blur

beats.narration_text: Aim a quantum particle at a wall it can't cross — and sometimes it's already on the far side.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Aim a quantum particle at a wall it can't cross — and sometimes it's already on the far side.
beats.new_visual_element: the person startled to see the particle on the other side of a wall
beats.start_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = a person facing a tall wall with a tiny particle in front of it]
beats.end_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = the person startled, the tiny particle now on the far side of the wall]
beats.video_animation_prompt: the person, wall and particle draw in, the particle disappears and reappears beyond the wall as the person looks startled; no hand visible, white background, napkin art doodle style
beats.negative_prompt: hand, fingers, arm, pencil, pen, marker, stylus, writing tool, shadow, paper texture, yellowing, gradient, photorealistic, 3D render, gray shading, color, brush, eraser, artifacts, distortion, camera movement, zoom, pan, wiggle, blur

beats.narration_text: A quantum wave travels toward a barrier it hasn't the energy to climb.
beats.tts_normalized_text: A quantum wave travels toward a barrier it hasn't the energy to climb.
beats.new_visual_element: an oscillating wave from the left, a tall red barrier block ahead
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: a baseline, an oscillating accent wave entering from the left moving right, a tall red barrier block on the right with its top above the wave's energy

beats.narration_text: Classically it must stop and bounce — but a wave can't just cut off at the wall.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Classically it must stop and bounce — but a wave can't just cut off at the wall.
beats.new_visual_element: a red 'stop' at the wall face that the wave refuses to obey
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: the wave reaches the barrier's left face; a red stop mark appears but the wave does not abruptly vanish at the edge

beats.narration_text: Inside the barrier the wave stops oscillating and instead decays, fading deeper in.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Inside the barrier the wave stops oscillating and instead decays, fading deeper in.
beats.new_visual_element: the wave morphs to an exponential decay curve inside the barrier
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: inside the barrier the oscillation morphs into a smooth exponential decay curve hugging the baseline, fading toward the far edge

beats.narration_text: A thick barrier lets it fade to almost nothing before reaching the far side.
beats.tts_normalized_text: A thick barrier lets it fade to almost nothing before reaching the far side.
beats.new_visual_element: a thick barrier; incident wave + decay reaching ~zero at the exit, nothing beyond
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: redraw with a THICK red barrier; incident wave then a decay curve that reaches essentially zero at the far edge; no wave beyond

beats.narration_text: But make the barrier thin, and the wave still has leftover height at the far edge.
beats.tts_normalized_text: But make the barrier thin, and the wave still has leftover height at the far edge.
beats.new_visual_element: the barrier narrows; the decay curve now still has amplitude at the exit
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: animate the barrier narrowing to thin; the decay curve now ends with visible leftover amplitude at the far edge

beats.narration_text: From that leftover, a full traveling wave relaunches on the other side.
beats.tts_normalized_text: From that leftover, a full traveling wave relaunches on the other side.
beats.new_visual_element: a smaller oscillating wave emerging past the thin barrier
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: from the leftover amplitude at the exit, draw a smaller-amplitude oscillating wave traveling right beyond the barrier

beats.narration_text: Its smaller height means a small but real chance the particle appears beyond the wall.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Its smaller height means a small but real chance the particle appears beyond the wall.
beats.new_visual_element: the transmitted wave labelled 'small but real chance'
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: label the small transmitted wave 'small but real chance'; contrast its height with the incident wave

beats.narration_text: It never climbed the wall; it leaked through — the barrier was simply thin enough.
beats.tts_normalized_text: It never climbed the wall; it leaked through — the barrier was simply thin enough.
beats.new_visual_element: full picture with a handwritten 'tunneled through, not over' label
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: hold on incident wave + decay tail inside + transmitted wave, with a handwritten label 'tunneled through, not over'; clean close
